params.body:
Vera, the review product, is removed. Elixir wrote its grant (`#agent-vera`, `review.publish|invite|sign` on `vera/<project>/*`) whenever `ELIXIR_CONTROL_VERA_KEY` was set. That key left elixir's crontab on 5 October, so the gateway has not served the hand since. This removes the code path, so the grant cannot come back by setting a variable.

- `App\Control\ReviewHand` is removed, along with its call in `ControlService` and the `control_vera_key` setting.
- `PolicyLog` no longer names `#agent-vera` or describes `vera/` resources. It still names a hand it does not know by its DID URL.
- Tests: the review hand's two tests are removed. The policy-log tests that used `review.invite` as the kind without a radius now use `branch.delete`, as control's tests do. The kind fixture loses `review.*`.

Rebased on `main` after #249 (run lifecycle). Full suite: 744 of 744.

No grant changes for the hands that remain, so no gateway configuration needs to be carried over.
params.title: Remove the review hand: Elixir no longer writes a grant for Vera
